text: Christopher Ward is the brand of Christopher Ward London Limited (company 05167936, registered office in Maidenhead); Companies House lists Christopher Ward (London) Holdings Limited as its owner of 75% or more of shares and voting rights, and BGF GP Limited as the holding company's only active person with significant control.
short: Christopher Ward London Limited is owned 75%+ by Christopher Ward (London) Holdings; its only active PSC is BGF GP Limited.
